metadata.question: Does the plume at (69.264212, -136.275745) discharged by the Mackenzie River into the Beaufort Sea apprear more milky compared to the adjacent open ocean (69.803894, -137.786365) waters in July 19, 2017?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use Sentinel-2 MSI (10 m) for the plume colour signal. - Date: single day 2017-07-19; allow ±1 week fallback if the exact day is missing. - Location: two small squares (300 m buffers) around the given points in the Beaufort Sea; EPSG:32607 (UTM zone 7 N) keeps pixel size ≈10 m. 2. Masking strategy: - Sentinel-2 “QA60” cloud mask (bits 10 & 11). - Add s2cloudless probability >40 % mask for extra safety over water. - Check valid pixel counts; if 0 after masking → C2. 3. Logic to distinguish “milky” vs “clear” ocean water: - Compute green/blue ratio = B3/B2 (higher ratio → more sediment → milkier). - If plume_ratio > ocean_ratio → plume is milkier → A (Yes). - If any result is None/NaN or ratio absurd (<0 or >10) → C3. - If no images at all → C1. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') plume_pt = ee.Geometry.Point([-136.275745, 69.264212]) ocean_pt = ee.Geometry.Point([-137.786365, 69.803894]) roi_plume = plume_pt.buffer(300) roi_ocean = ocean_pt.buffer(300) # 1. Sentinel-2 for 19 Jul 2017 ±1 day S2 = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') .filterBounds(plume_pt) .filterDate('2017-07-18','2017-07-20') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE',30))) if S2.size().getInfo()==0: print("No images for 19 Jul 2017.") print("C1") exit() # 2. Cloud / s2cloudless mask def maskS2(img): qa = img.select('QA60') cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1<<10).Or(qa.bitwiseAnd(1<<11)) s2cl = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_CLOUD_PROBABILITY').filter(ee.Filter.eq('system:index',img.get('system:index'))) prb = ee.Image(s2cl.first()).select('probability').gt(40) return img.updateMask(cloud.Not().And(prb.Not())) S2 = S2.map(maskS2) # 3. Green/Blue ratio (B3/B2) for milky water img = S2.median().select(['B3','B2']).rename(['green','blue']) ratio_img = img.expression('g/b',{'g':img.select('green'),'b':img.select('blue')}) # 4. Reduce in each ROI count_red = ee.Reducer.count() mean_red = ee.Reducer.mean() plume_count = ratio_img.reduceRegion(count_red,roi_plume,10,maxPixels=1e9).get('constant').getInfo() ocean_count = ratio_img.reduceRegion(count_red,roi_ocean,10,maxPixels=1e9).get('constant').getInfo() if plume_count==0 or ocean_count==0: print("No valid pixels after masking.") print("C2") exit() plume_ratio = ratio_img.reduceRegion(mean_red,roi_plume,10,maxPixels=1e9).get('constant').getInfo() ocean_ratio = ratio_img.reduceRegion(mean_red,roi_ocean,10,maxPixels=1e9).get('constant').getInfo() if plume_ratio is None or ocean_ratio is None or plume_ratio!=plume_ratio or ocean_ratio!=ocean_ratio: print("Ratio calculation failed.") print("C3") exit() print(f"Plume G/B: {plume_ratio:.2f} (Pixels: {int(plume_count)})") print(f"Ocean G/B: {ocean_ratio:.2f} (Pixels: {int(ocean_count)})") print("A" if plume_ratio > ocean_ratio else "B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

plume_pt = ee.Geometry.Point([-136.275745, 69.264212])
ocean_pt = ee.Geometry.Point([-137.786365, 69.803894])
roi_plume = plume_pt.buffer(300)
roi_ocean = ocean_pt.buffer(300)

# 1. Sentinel-2 for 19 Jul 2017 ±1 day
S2 = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR')
        .filterBounds(plume_pt)
        .filterDate('2017-07-18','2017-07-20')
        .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE',30)))
if S2.size().getInfo()==0:
    print("No images for 19 Jul 2017.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# 2. Cloud / s2cloudless mask
def maskS2(img):
    qa = img.select('QA60')
    cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1<<10).Or(qa.bitwiseAnd(1<<11))
    s2cl = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_CLOUD_PROBABILITY').filter(ee.Filter.eq('system:index',img.get('system:index')))
    prb = ee.Image(s2cl.first()).select('probability').gt(40)
    return img.updateMask(cloud.Not().And(prb.Not()))

S2 = S2.map(maskS2)

# 3. Green/Blue ratio (B3/B2) for milky water
img = S2.median().select(['B3','B2']).rename(['green','blue'])
ratio_img = img.expression('g/b',{'g':img.select('green'),'b':img.select('blue')})

# 4. Reduce in each ROI
count_red = ee.Reducer.count()
mean_red  = ee.Reducer.mean()
plume_count = ratio_img.reduceRegion(count_red,roi_plume,10,maxPixels=1e9).get('constant').getInfo()
ocean_count = ratio_img.reduceRegion(count_red,roi_ocean,10,maxPixels=1e9).get('constant').getInfo()
if plume_count==0 or ocean_count==0:
    print("No valid pixels after masking.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    exit()

plume_ratio = ratio_img.reduceRegion(mean_red,roi_plume,10,maxPixels=1e9).get('constant').getInfo()
ocean_ratio = ratio_img.reduceRegion(mean_red,roi_ocean,10,maxPixels=1e9).get('constant').getInfo()

if plume_ratio is None or ocean_ratio is None or plume_ratio!=plume_ratio or ocean_ratio!=ocean_ratio:
    print("Ratio calculation failed.")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    exit()

print(f"Plume G/B: {plume_ratio:.2f} (Pixels: {int(plume_count)})")
print(f"Ocean G/B: {ocean_ratio:.2f} (Pixels: {int(ocean_count)})")

print("<answer>A</answer>" if plume_ratio > ocean_ratio else "<answer>B</answer>")
